messages:
sue (producer): Uploaded raw interview + rough cut for Aurora Edge case: https://files.redwood/aurora-edge-raw.mp4 and transcript. Proposed embargo 2025-09-04 09:00 PT. Need legal on hero quote and greenlight for a perf chart excerpt.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks Sue. Can we keep hero <= 12 words. Planning long form blog + 45s social + accent reel.

sue (producer): Hero candidates in transcript: "Redwood helped Aurora Edge cut inference costs 3.1x during peak loads." and "We migrated without rearchitecting and saw steadier P95."

kevin (legal): Quick flags: convert any exact multiplier to ~3x unless finance signs off. Avoid absolutes like "without" 1"use "with minimal". Also need signed media release for the perf chart; redact any raw telemetry screenshots until we have it.

marta (prod-marketing): Draft hero suggestion: "Redwood helped Aurora Edge reduce inference spend ~3x while stabilizing tail latency." Lean and clear.

lily (growth): I'll build the landing and two CTAs: "Read the deep dive" vs "Register for hands-on webinar". Recommend webinar 2 weeks after embargo: 2025-09-18 11:00 PT.

tom (sales-ops): Routing ask: when form submits, tag utm_campaign=aurora-case and route to SDR-Aurora. Webhook sample:```curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood/lead-route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","source":"case-aurora","queue":"SDR-Aurora"}'``` Also add automation: if lead.role=="infra" notify #sdr-infra.

sue (producer): Confirmed speakers: Aurora infra lead, Aurora product lead, our Solutions Eng. I'll draft a 1-pager and a 3-bullet demo checklist.

kevin (legal): I'll sign off on the hero wording once transcript + benchmark appendix are attached to the approval email and release form is uploaded. If marketing wants the exact 3.1x callout, finance must confirm and we will cite the dataset.

marta (prod-marketing): Noted. We'll use the approx hero and link to appendix for readers who want details. Sue, redact competitor mention in the cut (one short line).

sue (producer): Redacted that line and uploaded new cut: aurora-edge-cut-v2.mp4.

publish-bot: upload complete: aurora-edge-cut-v2.mp4 (154MB)

lily (growth): I'll set up UTM tags and mock the landing variants. Also propose testing hero vs CTA to webinar for conversion.

tom (sales-ops): Smoke test plan: post a sample lead on 2025-09-02 09:30 PT and validate queue + tags. I'll document the automation mapping.

sue (producer): Timeline recap:
- Legal sign-off + release: by 2025-08-29
- Final edit + assets: by 2025-09-01
- Landing + routing ready: by 2025-09-02
- Embargo/publish: 2025-09-04 09:00 PT
- Webinar: 2025-09-18 11:00 PT
If anyone hits a blocker flag here.

kevin (legal): Approval email queued pending appendix attachment.

marta (prod-marketing): Internal prerelease: product, sales, and solutions get early access. Keep embargo tight. :zipper_mouth_face:

sue (producer): Closing 12 assets uploaded, legal looped, routing plan in flight. Will update when approval email is out.

marta (prod-marketing): Thanks team. End of thread.
